tools_helpful.evidence: Migration agent ended by running Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (session-log.txt:204); it reported the manifest as PASS (Windows.Desktop + rescap + runFullTrust all present).

tools_problematic.problem: Its Package.appxmanifest healthcheck (section 5b) only verifies TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust. It does NOT inspect <Extensions>, so it returned PASS on a manifest that carried a UWP-only windows.dialProtocol extension which makes package registration fail at launch with 0x80073CF6.
tools_problematic.evidence: Generated app/AdvancedCasting/Package.appxmanifest lines 40-44 keep <uap:Extension Category="windows.dialProtocol">; score notes migration-score.json winui_launchable:false, error AppxManifest.xml(30,10) 0x80070032 / 0x80073CF6.

tool_limitations.limitation: No detection of UWP-only manifest extension categories that the packaged WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK stack cannot register.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a manifest scan that FAILs (or WARNs) when <Extensions> contains UWP-activation-model categories (windows.dialProtocol, windows.dialReceiver, windows.backgroundTasks, windows.appService, etc.).

doc_errors.wrong: Lists `<uap:Extension>` among the UWP-manifest content to 'merge into the scaffold's' with no caveat, implying all extensions are safe to carry over.
doc_errors.correct: Many UWP `<Extensions>` categories rely on the UWP AppContainer/activation model and are not supported by packaged WinUI 3; copying them verbatim causes 0x80073CF6 registration failures. Only carry over extensions known to work in packaged desktop apps; drop UWP-only ones.

special_apis.special_handling: Not registrable by the Windows App SDK packaging stack; must be removed from Package.appxmanifest. The receiver functionality has no packaged-WinUI3 manifest equivalent and must be re-implemented with Win32/WinRT APIs if needed.

errors_encountered.error: Package could not be registered: AppxManifest.xml(30,10) error 0x80070032 — windows.dialProtocol extension 'The request is not supported.' (0x80073CF6). Build succeeds (0 errors) but both 'winapp run' and 'dotnet run' fail to launch.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The dev-agent merged the UWP <uap:Extension Category="windows.dialProtocol"> block into the WinUI 3 manifest (following MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:440 which lists <uap:Extension> as merge-safe). The packaged WinUI 3 stack cannot register this UWP-only extension.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the unsupported <uap:Extension> entry (the whole <Extensions> block here) from Package.appxmanifest; keep only runFullTrust + supported capabilities/extensions.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App built with 0 errors and Validate-UwpMigration PASSed, but the app never launched (registration failure discovered only at scoring).
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a — failure was silent; agent never attempted a launch
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Neither the skill prose nor the validator flags UWP-only manifest extensions; the validator's manifest check gave a false-PASS.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved during migration; surfaced by the scoring task.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add an unsupported-extension check to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 and a caveat in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md so UWP-only <Extensions> are dropped before the first launch.

missing_tooling.need: A manifest-extension allowlist/denylist check in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The blocking 0x80073CF6 launch failure that zeroed the score.
